description: The same document and pack, declaring Core "0.3", for an evaluator that knows FS_electrical and FS_mechanical: the official extensions at 0.1.0 are evaluated for Core 0.3 documents too (each one's 1.2), so every FS_electrical rule is evaluated, exactly as for the "0.2" document; only the EXT_furniture rule is FS-RULES-009.
